title: Curvature-Scaled Sharpness-Aware Minimization: Convergence Beyond Smoothness
abstract: arXiv:2610.29192v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) has established itself as a widely used method for training deep neural networks. Despite its popularity, existing convergence guarantees for SAM-type methods require smoothness, a restrictive assumption. Generalized smoothness conditions have recently been proposed in the analysis of gradient methods but remain underexplored for SAM. To analyze the effect of SAM's perturbation under generalized smoothness, we use relative gradient distortion to quantify how the sharpness-aware direction departs from the original gradient. Under $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness, we show that this distortion can become unbounded near stationarity for SAM and at large gradients for its unnormalized variant (USAM), with examples where SAM cycles and USAM diverges. We then establish a necessary condition for uniform distortion control among perturbations along the gradient whose nonnegative multipliers depend only on its norm. Moti

translated_title: 曲率缩放的锐度感知最小化：超越平滑性的收敛性
translated_abstract: 锐度感知最小化（SAM）已成为训练深度神经网络的一种广泛使用的方法。尽管其应用广泛，但现有的SAM类方法的收敛性保证都要求平滑性这一限制性假设。广义平滑条件最近在梯度方法的分析中被提出，但对于SAM仍未得到充分探索。为了分析SAM的扰动在广义平滑性下的影响，我们使用相对梯度失真来量化锐度感知方向偏离原始梯度的程度。在$(L_0,L_1)$-平滑性条件下，我们证明这种失真对于SAM在接近平稳点时可能变得无界，对于其未归一化变体（USAM）在大梯度时可能变得无界，并给出了SAM发生循环、USAM发散的具体例子。随后，我们针对沿梯度方向的扰动（其非负乘子仅依赖于梯度范数）建立了实现统一失真控制的必要条件。
tldr: 该论文利用相对梯度失真揭示了SAM在广义平滑条件下失真可能无界、SAM会循环而USAM会发散的现象，建立了梯度扰动统一失真控制的必要条件，并由此提出曲率缩放的锐度感知最小化方法，实现了超越平滑性假设的收敛性保证。
